Product Details
Explore how AI augments rather than replaces human expertise by automating repetitive tasks, accelerating threat detection, managing large-scale data and enhancing incident response. Gain strategies for identifying AI blind spots, addressing automation bias, and continuously adapting models to balance AI and human decision-making. The course content highlights the necessity of critical assessment and refinement of AI outputs, ensuring cybersecurity professionals are not only users of AI tools but active contributors to their improvement and accountability.
Learning Experience:
Text and video-based content
Learning activities

Who Will Benefit
This course is designed for cybersecurity professionals who are interested in addressing the positive and negative implications of AI security and improving its integration in security processes. Recommended prerequisite knowledge includes an understanding of cybersecurity concepts, principles and best practices and knowledge of cybersecurity roles and AI capabilities.
Key Topics
Artificial intelligence and machine learning
Program management
Organizational alignment
Learning Outcomes
Identify and address AI blind spots and limitations
Identify weaknesses in AI security tools using a data-driven approach
Discover strategies to balance AI tools with human decision-making
Build stronger security programs by combining AI and human expertise
Benefits
Learn strategies for identifying AI blind spots, addressing automation bias, and continuously adapting models to balance AI and human decision-making
Participate in activities centered on real-world applications
Earn CPE credits
Program Completion
Learners have 60 days from the date of purchase to complete the entire course. Those who successfully complete this course will receive a digital Validation of Completion and earn continuing professional education (CPE) credits. We recommend that you download and retain the Validation of Completion for your personal records.
To receive a Validation of Completion and earn CPE credits, learners must:
Complete the learning experience
Pass the assessment
Complete the learning experience evaluation

CPE Credit Reporting
CPE credits earned from this learning experience will automatically be reported for ISC2 credentials on the first day of every month. Please allow up to 10 business days for processing.
CPE credits earned for this learning experience may also be eligible for continuing professional education credits for non-ISC2 certifications. Please visit the continuing education requirements established by the credentialing organization for eligibility.
For questions related to ISC2 CPE credits or the CPE portal not covered in the handbook, please contact us via our online form.
